intro: Explore a selection of our on-site HT/LT installations, custom-fabricated electrical panels, industrial wiring executions, and testing operations—reflecting our focus on workmanship, neat cable management, and site safety.

items.title: Main LT PCC & Switchgear Room Installation
items.caption: Multi-compartment floor-mounted LT PCC and switchgear assembly installed on a concrete plinth with rotary isolators, digital metering, and overhead cable tray.

items.title: Raymond Retail Showroom Electrical & Lighting
items.caption: Complete retail showroom electrification featuring illuminated storefront signage, warm display spotlights, and interior ambient lighting.

items.title: Deep Borewell Earthing & Site Safety Execution
items.caption: Mechanized earthing borewell drilling executed by our PPE-equipped site team for low-resistance protective earth pits.

items.title: 40 kVAR APFC & Capacitor Bank Panel
items.caption: Custom-fabricated 40 kVAR automatic power factor correction panel with digital APFC relay, selector switches, indicator lamps, and dedicated busbar chamber.

items.title: ATS Changeover & Ferruled Distribution Panel
items.caption: Internal panel wiring showcasing motorized changeover/ATS switch, rotary isolator, MCB banks, and neatly ferruled terminal blocks.

items.title: 3-Phase RYB Busbar & 4-Pole MCCB Assembly
items.caption: Colour-coded RYB and neutral copper busbar termination onto a 4-pole MCCB isolator inside a powder-coated enclosure.

items.title: Legrand Lighting, Power & UPS DB Setup
items.caption: Wall-mounted Legrand Lighting DB, Power DB, UPS DB, and 3-phase over-voltage cut-off device with structured conduit entry.

items.title: Three-Phase Power & Lighting DB Wiring
items.caption: Open-door inspection of Legrand Power DB and Lighting DB displaying colour-coded 3-phase busbars, incomer MCCB, and outgoing MCB circuits.

items.title: Floor-Standing MCB & Metering Panel
items.caption: Powder-coated floor-standing distribution board with windowed MCB compartments, digital volt/amp meters, rotary isolator, and safety signage.

items.title: Park Avenue Showroom Lighting & Signage
items.caption: Turnkey commercial retail electrical fit-out for Park Avenue including backlit fascia signage, linear ceiling fixtures, and track lighting.

items.title: Retail Store Recessed & Linear Ceiling Lighting
items.caption: Precision-aligned recessed LED downlights, perimeter spotlights, and linear HVAC/lighting ceiling integration for a retail outlet.

items.title: Architectural Wall-Wash & Accent Lighting
items.caption: Dual-direction architectural wall-wash installation combining recessed ceiling downlights with floor-recessed uplights.

items.title: Multi-Lamp Recessed & Track Lighting
items.caption: Commercial showroom ceiling featuring multi-lamp recessed LED fixtures and glass-partition track spotlights.

items.title: Overhead MS Conduit Ceiling Routing
items.caption: Parallel heavy-gauge MS electrical conduit runs clamped neatly across concrete beams during commercial fit-out.

items.title: Multi-Meter Board & Perforated Cable Tray
items.caption: Centralized energy meter room with 15 digital sub-meters, numbered isolation switches, and overhead perforated GI cable tray.
